'''Shalo Sherin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. He was forced out of his family for unknown reasons (though according to rumors, he attempted to have his older brother [[Death/Legends|murdered]]). He soon turned to crime, which suited him, as he was completely uninterested in morality.<ref name="LoNH" />
